understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level and continue until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, while gravity pulls the player downward and can cause multi-tile vertical movement. CLICK removes a clickable tile without moving the player, which can alter the route. Landing on spike tiles ends the current attempt; each level allows two attempts with up to 50 turns. Undo/restart follows a failed attempt, preserving the failure in recent context.
